name: Southern Alliance Mining Ltd.
summary: Southern Alliance Mining Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, and processing of iron ores in Malaysia. The company primarily explores for iron ore, gold, precious and base metals, and rare earth deposits. Its flagship project, the Chaah Mine, is located in Johor, Malaysia. The company also provides pipe coating materials and management services. The company has a strategic alliance with Brazilian Critical Minerals Limited for the development and distribution of rare earth products. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Kuantan, Malaysia.
